title: Microspan sequencing & per-kernel lineage telemetry for attention execution
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce a compact microspan sequencing layer and kernel-lineage tags to improve attribution for attention-related execution paths (prefill & decode). This ticket defines NVTX naming, microspan boundaries, and OTLP export mappings so per-kernel metrics (latency, SM utilization, memory bytes) can be stitched back to high-level request phases and attention sub-steps.
acceptance_criteria: 1) NVTX and span naming documented and adhered to across prefill and decode; 2) Per-kernel tags exported via OTLP with kernel lineage id; 3) Dashboard shows per-request breakdown (attention-prefill, KV-copy, attend, matmul reduction) and matches microbenchmarks within 5%; 4) Backwards-compatible when telemetry off; 5) Benchmarks show <2% overhead in 99th percentile latency when enabled
implementation_steps: Define microspan taxonomy and NVTX naming conventions (phase, subphase, kernel_role, kernel_variant)
Add lightweight kernel-lineage ID (64-bit fingerprint) in runtime hot path and stitch into NVTX ranges
Emit per-kernel metrics (duration_ns, bytes_in/out, occupancy_hint) to telemetry layer with lineage tag
Implement microspan stitching logic in trace exporter: span -> microspan -> request-level aggregation
Create Grafana panels and logs-to-trace correlation queries for QA
Run systematic perf experiments across Llama-like and MPT-like model configs and record overhead
comments: 2025-01-16 - Kickoff: scoped to prefill + decode attention hotpaths. Decided to prefer 64-bit lineage fingerprint to keep NVTX payload small.
2025-01-22 - Prototype NVTX names: 'rw.phase:prefill|sub:kv_copy|krole:kv_copy|kvar:fp16_gemm' — sent to eng-telemetry Slack for review.
2025-01-29 - PR opened: runtime: attach-lineage-to-nvtx (github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4876). Microbench harness shows 1.4% median overhead, 1.9% p99 on a 4-token decode workload.
2025-02-03 - Design review with Observability: agreed on OTLP attribute keys 'rw.lineage_id' and 'rw.kernel_role' and retention shape. Asked to include occupancy_hint metric.
2025-02-07 - QA notes: edge-case where kernel_variant is null for fallback kernels; added fallback mapping in exporter to avoid empty labels in Grafana.
2025-02-09 - Engineering review: requested adding unit test for lineage collision probability and a short explainer for SDK consumers about span explosion risks when telemetry is toggled on.
